# Dirk M. Luchtenburg

**Associate Professor of Mechanical Engineering**  
[The Cooper Union](https://cooper.edu)

*Nonlinear dynamics · Modeling · Control*

My research focuses on the modeling, analysis, and control of dynamical systems, with contributions spanning nonlinear dynamics, reduced-order modeling, fluid mechanics, and autonomous systems. My work combines mathematical analysis, computation, and physical experimentation.
